text:
alex: Nightly evals showing ~6% timeout rate on qa_prompt_set this morning. CI hung on 'summarize_long' for several models. Anyone else seeing this?

devci-bot: nightly-evals job #4823 finished with status: partial_fail. Failed tests: qa_prompt_set/summarize_long (timeouts: 12). Artifacts: <link_to_artifacts>

maria: I noticed this too. It started after the runtime kernel bump yesterday (nvml/1.2.0). Could be batching or scheduling changes.

sam: Is it deterministic? Did you rerun the failing job with the same seed? I see nondeterministic timeouts sometimes when sequence length distribution shifts.

alex: I reran with the same SEED=42 twice: first run succeeded, second timed out. So looks nondet.

irene: Logs show a stall pattern, snippet:
```
[2026-03-17 03:05:12] model forward step took 512ms
[2026-03-17 03:05:20] waiting for batch completion > 10s
```

maria: Could be infra preemption. @eng-infra any CPU steal/ooms around that window?

devci-bot: node-metrics for node-17: cpu_steal: 0.3%, gpu_util spike 95% for ~3s, mem_pressure 22%.

sam: Also, quantized variants tend to show higher tail latency. Are failures concentrated on int8/q4 runs?

alex: Yes — failures were mostly on q4_0 and int8-pt variants. Non-quantized fp16 runs passed. Might be cache layout or kernel ordering causing stalls.

irene: Repro steps I'd run:
- loop single test 100x with seed sweep
- collect triton/gpu traces + perf counters
- temporarily bump timeout to 60s to see slow vs hung
Command:
```bash
for s in {1..100}; do SEED=$s pytest tests/qa_prompt_set::test_summarize_long -k summarize_long || echo fail $s; done
```

maria: I'll spin that loop on a dedicated node and attach nvprof. If nondet, capture env (CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES, kernel version, NVML).

alex: Filed issue: github.com/redwood-inference/infra/issues/712 with artifacts and initial notes. Assigning to @sam and @maria. Will post loop results when done.

devci-bot: linked CI reruns scheduled (3 reruns).

sam: If quantization is the trigger, we should fallback nightly quant runs to fp16 until root cause fixed and mark the test flaky so it doesn't block rollouts.

irene: :thumbsup: I'll prepare a minimal reproducer that isolates the KV cache path and disable continuous batching to see if the stall goes away.

maria: Quick update: after 200 iterations on node-22 we saw 2 timeouts. Attached perf traces. Early signal: cache eviction spikes just before the stall.

alex: Great data. Next: run with manual cache warmup, turn off preemptive batching, and compare against pre-bump kernel image. We'll try a canary revert if that narrows it down.
